type: pre-specified post hoc reference-reserve sensitivity analysis
description: Sensitivity analysis of the KV reserve parameter on the fresh production latency headroom results. Evaluates reserves 0.82, 0.90, and 1.00.
interpretation_rules: A. If 0.90 and/or 1.00 largely eliminate both P(D) and unconditional opportunity-weighted headroom: -> evidence that the original result is strongly reserve-specific.
B. If positive opportunity/headroom remains materially present: -> evidence that the result is not solely an artifact of reserve=0.82.
C. Do NOT define a numerical 'success' threshold after results. Report the complete sensitivity curve and effect sizes.
D. This experiment varies reserve only. It does NOT isolate KV-footprint ordering. Therefore do not claim it completely solves reference dependence.
